rules.latency: original dual-condition warmup; nearest-rank; p99.9 null below 10000 samples
rules.exceedances: strict visible latency > threshold; equality excluded
rules.exposure: first measured actual sent_ns through last measured received_ns
rules.frequency: count / observed exposure minutes; final minute uses actual exposure
rules.minute_buckets: left-closed/right-open, except final observed endpoint is included
rules.cluster: adjacent exceedance receive gaps <= configured gap form one cluster
rules.cluster_intervals: successive cluster-start receive times; fewer than 5 yields null
rules.interpretation: descriptive only; truncated runs are censored; no periodicity claim
